title: Synthesis 2: first diffusion-tested results, fch-bilayer established, and three lessons for testing W, B and H
summary: Since synthesis 1, P rose 38 -> 54 and P_BD 0 -> 12. fch-bilayer is established up to SIBWD (C:inherited-contents met); phase_membrane's ring is the first diffusion-tested capability, while its division is not; kstrail swimming is matched by a Laplacian-only twin. Lessons: body-made cargoes pass W under a uniformly slow twin (law contrast-1 ~ Dc^-0.93), drift-made layers are the robust BD signal, and H on continuous traits must condition on the trait at birth.
